description: The ophys module on synthetic recordings with known shifts and cells: SciScan raw, TIFF and multi-ROI ScanImage files are read, the data variables are set up by the module's tool, and motion correction, image statistics (a computed fragment), ROI detection (the correlation image, and Quicky's), signal extraction, ΔF/F, deconvolution, denoising, downsampling, aligning sessions, ROI curation, the viewer's frames, a method previewed on the first frames (writing nothing) and the brain region at a FOV's position give the values of the ground truth, which make_data.py computes from the scenes directly (the deconvolution with a general optimiser). The module's dashboard page and its atlas are served by app.plugins and modules.resource; the FOV map's injection sites are kept with modules.saveData, as JSON text given back exactly.
